note: Forest Service campground on a ridge top in the middle of the Chadwick motorcycle and ATV trail system, about 80 miles of trails for vehicles 50 inches wide or less; most visitors come to ride, and it fills on fine-weather weekends. A host lives on site year-round; check in on arrival. Riding needs a separate Chadwick permit. --Claude
summary: General developed campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp: 45 sites with showers, flush toilets, tent-only and group sites, and a year-round host; the riding trailheads are separate day-use areas where overnight camping is barred. Kept. Fees $15/$25 (group $75); 50-amp at 26 electric sites, no water/sewer hookups; max rig 45 ft (FS recommendation); 22 sites reservable Mar-Nov on rec.gov, the rest FCFS, all FCFS Dec-Feb; 14-night max. Season (manual, year-round) untouched. Phone 417-683-4428 to add. Pin is at the entrance; optional move into the loops.
flags: OHV QUESTION (decided: keep, a general campground with an OHV side): the FS page says 'Visitors to the campground mostly come for the plentiful off-road vehicle trails' and that it 'lies in the center of the Chadwick Motorcycle and ATV use area'. But it is a full developed campground: 45 sites incl. 5 tent-only and 2 group, 'warm water shower building', flush/vault toilets, drinking water, year-round host, family/group camping. The trailheads are separate day-use areas ('At the Trailheads: No overnight camping in day use areas at any time of year'). No horses. AWH may still judge it OHV-dominated, since the FS itself says riders are most of the visitors.

ALERTS on the FS page: 'Forest Order - Trail 119 Closure Extended (Chadwick Motorized Trail System)' and 'Delays on Forest Road 557'; neither is the campground or its access (Lookout Road off Hwy H, paved to the entrance).
PHONE: entry has none. FS: 'Ava-Cassville-Willow Springs Ranger Station... Phone: 417-683-4428 ext 120'; rec.gov facility_phone 417-683-4428. Suggest adding 417-683-4428.
